description: Export one of the user's CVs in the EU's official Europass format (XML or JSON-LD) for EU job portals and applications. Returns the file content (truncated if very large). PRO. Use when an application asks for a Europass CV.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: export_takemeup_europass
title: Export Europass XML / JSON (PRO)
